title: Surreal Dreamscape
description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a large dog covered in stars and patterns blowing bubbles that contain tiny surreal scenes. A silhouetted man stands observing while a giant woman's face with crescent moon and skulls emerges from a framed painting, her hair flowing into a swirling cosmic sky with a blood moon dripping red liquid. Three horned female figures stand on a wavy landscape to the left.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal psychedelic scene featuring a large colorful dog covered in stars and cosmic patterns sitting in the foreground blowing transparent bubbles containing tiny figures and scenes. A black silhouette of a man stands watching. Behind them is a large framed painting of a beautiful woman's face with black tears, crescent moon on forehead, and skulls in her flowing multicolored hair that merges with a swirling starry sky containing a large dripping blood moon. Three horned female figures stand on a wavy colorful ground to the left, all rendered in a vibrant imaginative painting style.
